slok_sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
transliteration:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana |
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi ||
translation_en: You have a right only to perform your prescribed duty, but never to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
translation_hi: तेरा कर्म करने में ही अधिकार है, उसके फलों में कभी नहीं। इसलिए तू कर्मों के फल का हेतु मत बन तथा तेरी अकर्मण्यता (कर्म न करने) में भी आसक्ति न हो।
translation_te: కర్మలను ఆచరించడానికే నీకు అధికారము కలదు గాని, వాటి ఫలితాలపై ఎన్నడూ లేదు. కర్మఫలానికి నీవే కారణమనుకోకు, అలాగని కర్మలను చేయడం మానవద్దు.
explanation: This verse is the cornerstone of Karma Yoga. Lord Krishna instructs that when a person fixes their focus on results—such as awards, promotions, praises, or outcomes beyond their control—anxiety, jealousy, and disappointment inevitably follow. True mastery lies in dedicating 100% of one's energy to high-quality action in the present moment, treating work itself as an art and spiritual offering, while releasing attachment to external rewards.
core_concepts: Nishkama Karma, Action without Attachment, Equanimity, Focus on Duty
life_situations: career, comparison, promotion, workplace injustice, overthinking results, exam anxiety, fear of failure, performance stress

slok_sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत॥
transliteration:
mātrā-sparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ |
āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṁs titikṣasva bhārata ||
translation_en: O son of Kunti, the contact of the senses with their objects gives rise to fleeting feelings of heat and cold, pleasure and pain. These experiences are temporary, coming and going like the seasons. Learn to tolerate them with forbearance, O Bharata.
translation_hi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र! सर्दी-गर्मी और सुख-दुःख देने वाले इन्द्रिय और विषयों के संयोग तो क्षणिक और अनित्य हैं। इसलिए हे भारत! तू उनको सहन करना सीख।
translation_te: ఓ కుంతీపుత్రా! ఇంద్రియాలతో విషయాల సంపర్కం వల్ల కలిగే శీతోష్ణాలు, సుఖదుఃఖాలు తాత్కాలికమైనవి, కాలక్రమేణా వచ్చిపోయేవి. వాటిని సహనంతో ఎదుర్కోవడానికి అలవాటు పడుము.
explanation: Life brings inevitable cycles of highs and lows—moments of celebration and phases of hardship. When an individual realizes that emotions, discomfort, and circumstances are transient like winter and summer, they develop emotional fortitude (Titiksha). Resilience is not suppressing pain, but recognizing that this too shall pass.
core_concepts: Titiksha (Forbearance), Impermanence, Emotional Resilience, Equanimity
life_situations: emotional pain, grief, heartbreak, tough times, financial hardship, coping with loss, mental fatigue, mood swings

slok_sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि-
न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो
न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
transliteration:
na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin
nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ |
ajo nityaḥ śāśvato 'yaṁ purāṇo
na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre ||
translation_en: The soul is never born, nor does it ever die; nor having once existed, does it ever cease to be. The soul is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval. It is not slain when the body is slain.
translation_hi: आत्मा न कभी जन्मती है और न कभी मरती है; न ही यह एक बार होकर फिर कभी नहीं होने वाली है। यह अजन्मी, नित्य, सनातन और पुरातन है; शरीर के नष्ट होने पर भी यह नष्ट नहीं होती।
translation_te: ఆత్మకు పుట్టుక లేదు, మరణం లేదు. ఇది ఎన్నడూ నశించనిది, నిత్యమైనది, శాశ్వతమైనది, పురాతనమైనది. శరీరం నశించినప్పటికీ ఆత్మ నశించదు.
explanation: Lord Krishna dispels existential despair and fear of death by revealing the indestructible nature of the soul. Understanding that our true essence is beyond physical forms, titles, and transient physical realities removes existential dread and grants supreme courage in facing life's greatest tribulations.
core_concepts: Atman (The Soul), Eternity, Immortality, Transcending Fear of Death
life_situations: fear of death, bereavement, loss of loved ones, existential crisis, identity crisis, seeking purpose

slok_sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
transliteration:
yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya |
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate ||
translation_en: Perform your duty with composure, O Dhananjaya, abandoning all attachment to success and failure. Such equanimity of mind is known as Yoga.
translation_hi: हे धनंजय! तू आसक्ति को त्यागकर तथा सिद्धि और असिद्धि में समान भाव रखकर अपने कर्तव्य कर्म कर। यह समत्व-भाव ही 'योग' कहलाता है।
translation_te: ఓ అర్జునా! ఆసక్తిని విడిచిపెట్టి, గెలుపు ఓటములందు సమదృష్టి కలిగి నీ కర్మలను ఆచరించుము. ఇటువంటి మానసిక సమత్వమే 'యోగం' అని పిలువబడుతుంది.
explanation: Krishna defines the practical essence of Yoga: 'Samatvam'—mental equanimity. When a person remains steady regardless of whether an endeavor yields triumph or defeat, their inner peace remains invulnerable. Decisions made from this steady posture are clear, unbiased, and effective.
core_concepts: Samatvam (Equanimity), Yoga of Balance, Freedom from Outcome Anxiety
life_situations: fear of failure, startup setbacks, decision paralysis, emotional volatility, perfectionism, performance pressure

slok_sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
transliteration:
dhyāyato viṣayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣūpajāyate |
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho 'bhijāyate ||
translation_en: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment to them. From attachment desire arises, and from unfulfilled desire springs anger.
translation_hi: विषयों का निरन्तर चिंतन करने वाले मनुष्य की उनमें आसक्ति हो जाती है। आसक्ति से कामना उत्पन्न होती है, और कामना में विघ्न पड़ने से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है।
translation_te: ఇంద్రియ విషయాలను నిరంతరం చింతించడం వల్ల వాటిపై వ్యామోహం ఏర్పడుతుంది. వ్యామోహం నుండి కోరిక పుడుతుంది, కోరిక తీరనప్పుడు క్రోధం రగులుకుంటుంది.
explanation: Krishna charts the psychological ladder of fall. It begins not with an explosion of fury, but with innocent dwelling on desires. As fixations deepen, any obstruction to our expectations instantly transforms into bitter rage. Understanding this progression allows us to catch anger at its root thought.
core_concepts: Psychology of Desire, Root Cause of Anger, Mindful Attention
life_situations: anger control, emotional outburst, jealousy, relationship conflict, frustration, unmet expectations, road rage

slok_sanskrit:
क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः।
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति॥
transliteration:
krodhād bhavati saṁmohaḥ saṁmohāt smṛti-vibhramaḥ |
smṛti-bhraṁśād buddhi-nāśo buddhi-nāśāt praṇaśyati ||
translation_en: From anger arises complete delusion; from delusion comes confusion of memory; from confused memory comes loss of intellect and discrimination; and through the destruction of intellect, a person is ruined.
translation_hi: क्रोध से सम्मोह (मूढ़भाव) उत्पन्न होता है, सम्मोह से स्मृति भ्रमित हो जाती है, स्मृति भ्रष्ट होने से बुद्धि का नाश हो जाता है, और बुद्धि के नाश होने से मनुष्य का पतन हो जाता है।
translation_te: క్రోధం వల్ల అవివేకం పుడుతుంది, అవివేకం వల్ల విచక్షణ మరియు జ్ఞాపకశక్తి నశిస్తుంది, విచక్షణ నశించడంతో బుద్ధి నశిస్తుంది, బుద్ధి నశించిన మనిషి సర్వనాశనమౌతాడు.
explanation: This verse warns of the catastrophic cascade of rage. When overwhelmed by anger, our logical intellect (Buddhi) shuts down, causing us to say and do destructive things we regret for years. Krishna urges mindfulness to halt this chain reaction before it damages our lives and relationships.
core_concepts: Intellect Preservation, Calming the Mind, Emotional Destruction Prevention
life_situations: controlling rage, domestic arguments, impulsive regret, toxic arguments, managing conflicts, temper tantrums

slok_sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं
समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे
स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी॥
transliteration:
āpūryamāṇam acala-pratiṣṭhaṁ
samudram āpaḥ praviśanti yadvat |
tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśanti sarve
sa śāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī ||
translation_en: Just as the ocean remains undisturbed though filled by countless rivers continuously entering it, so does a person into whom all desires enter without disturbing their mind attain genuine peace, not the one who craves desires.
translation_hi: जैसे सब ओर से जल से परिपूर्ण अचल समुद्र में नदियाँ आकर मिलती हैं फिर भी वह विचलित नहीं होता, वैसे ही जिस व्यक्ति में सभी कामनाएं विलीन हो जाती हैं, वही वास्तविक शांति पाता है, कामनाओं के पीछे भागने वाला नहीं।
translation_te: సమస్త నదీజలాలు నిరంతరం ప్రవేశించినా సముద్రం ఎలాగైతే నిశ్చలంగా తన పరిధిని దాటకుండా స్థిరంగా ఉంటుందో, అలాగే కోరికలు ప్రవేశించినా కలవరపడని వాడే శాంతిని పొందుతాడు.
explanation: Krishna provides the magnificent ocean metaphor. The ocean does not dry up when rivers cease, nor does it flood when rivers gush into it. Similarly, when your sense of self-worth is deep and anchored within, outside opinions, flattery, insults, and cravings do not disrupt your profound tranquility.
core_concepts: Oceanic Peace, Sthitaprajna, Inner Grounding, Freedom from Neediness
life_situations: overthinking, seeking validation, social media comparison, craving external approval, inner peace, anxiety

slok_sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः॥
transliteration:
niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hy akarmaṇaḥ |
śarīra-yātrāpi ca te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ ||
translation_en: Perform your obligatory duties, for action is far superior to inaction. Even the bare maintenance of your physical body would not be possible without action.
translation_hi: तू अपने नियत कर्तव्य कर्म को कर, क्योंकि कर्म न करने की अपेक्षा कर्म करना श्रेष्ठ है। कर्म न करने से तेरा शरीर-निर्वाह भी सिद्ध नहीं हो सकता।
translation_te: నీ నిర్దేశిత కర్తవ్యాన్ని నీవు ఆచరించుము. ఎందుకంటే కర్మ చేయకపోవడం కన్నా కర్మ చేయడం శ్రేష్ఠమైనది. కర్మ చేయకపోతే నీ శరీరపోషణ కూడా సాధ్యపడదు.
explanation: Procrastination, escapism, and paralysis by analysis often mask themselves as spiritual hesitation or exhaustion. Krishna firmly tells Arjuna that duty and meaningful effort cannot be avoided. Taking constructive action creates momentum, clarity, and life vitality.
core_concepts: Overcoming Procrastination, Constructive Action, Living Responsibility
life_situations: procrastination, laziness, feeling stuck, lack of motivation, avoiding responsibilities, despair

slok_sanskrit:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते॥
transliteration:
yad yad ācarati śreṣṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ |
sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate ||
translation_en: Whatever standard a great person sets by their actions, common people follow. Whatever standard they establish by exemplary acts, all the world pursues.
translation_hi: श्रेष्ठ पुरुष जैसा आचरण करते हैं, अन्य पुरुष भी वैसा ही आचरण करते हैं। वे जो प्रमाण या आदर्श स्थापित करते हैं, संसार उसी का अनुसरण करता है।
translation_te: ఉత్తమ వ్యక్తి ఏ విధమైన ఆచరణ చేస్తాడో, సామాన్య ప్రజలు కూడా దాన్నే అనుసరిస్తారు. ఆ ఉత్తముడు ఏ ప్రమాణాన్ని నెలకొల్పుతాడో ప్రపంచమంతా దాన్నే పాటిస్తుంది.
explanation: Krishna highlights the profound responsibility of leaders, parents, and mentors. Our integrity and work ethic reverberate far beyond ourselves. When in doubt, act as the role model you wish had guided you.
core_concepts: Leadership by Example, Social Responsibility, Moral Influence
life_situations: leadership challenges, parenting doubts, team guidance, personal integrity, mentoring, workplace culture

slok_sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥
transliteration:
śreyān sva-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣṭhitāt |
sva-dharme nidhanaṁ śreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ ||
translation_en: It is far better to perform one's own natural duty, even if imperfectly, than to master the duty of another. Better to perish striving in one's own path; following another's path is fraught with fear and danger.
translation_hi: दूसरों के कर्तव्य को भली-भाँति निभाने की अपेक्षा अपने प्राकृतिक कर्तव्य का दोषयुक्त भी पालन करना अधिक कल्याणकारी है। अपने धर्म में मरना भी श्रेयस्कर है, दूसरों का धर्म भय उत्पन्न करने वाला है।
translation_te: బాగా ఆచరించిన ఇతరుల ధర్మం కన్నా లోపభూయిష్టమైనా సరే తన స్వధర్మాన్ని ఆచరించడమే మేలు. స్వధర్మంలో మరణించినా శ్రేయస్కరమే కానీ పరధర్మం భయంకరమైనది.
explanation: One of the most revolutionary psychological insights of the Gita: Swadharma. Trying to live someone else's career, expectations, or life path leads to emptiness and chronic impostor syndrome. Honor your innate nature, your genuine strengths, and walk your authentic path with dignity.
core_concepts: Swadharma (Authentic Calling), Rejecting Comparison, Embracing Authenticity
life_situations: career confusion, peer pressure, parental career expectations, impostor syndrome, comparing with others, discovering purpose

slok_sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata |
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham ||
translation_en: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in righteousness, O descendant of Bharata, and a predominant rise of unrighteousness—at that time I manifest Myself.
translation_hi: हे भारत! जब-जब धर्म की हानि और अधर्म की वृद्धि होती है, तब-तब मैं अपने रूप को रचता हूँ अर्थात प्रकट होता हूँ।
translation_te: ఓ భరతవంశీయుడా! ఎప్పుడెప్పుడు ధర్మానికి హాని కలుగుతుందో మరియు అధర్మం మితిమీరిపోతుందో, అప్పుడు నన్ను నేను సృష్టించుకొని అవతరిస్తాను.
explanation: This historic assurance proves that cosmic justice and moral balance are continually restored. When darkness, corruption, and confusion seem overpowering in the world or in personal life, divine grace is already orchestrating renewal and truth.
core_concepts: Avatar, Restoration of Cosmic Balance, Hope in Dark Times
life_situations: hopelessness about the world, facing corruption, moral injustice, losing faith in goodness, spiritual reassurance

slok_sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṁ pavitram iha vidyate |
tat svayaṁ yoga-saṁsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati ||
translation_en: In this world, there is nothing as purifying as spiritual knowledge. One who has attained purity through selfless action and yoga realizes this truth within their own heart in due course of time.
translation_hi: इस संसार में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र करने वाला निःसंदेह कुछ भी नहीं है। योग में भली-भाँति सिद्ध हुआ मनुष्य समय पाकर उस ज्ञान को स्वतः ही अपने हृदय में अनुभव कर लेता है।
translation_te: ఈ లోకంలో జ్ఞానంతో సమానమైన పవిత్రమైనది ఏదీ లేదు. కర్మయోగంలో పరిపక్వత సాధించిన వ్యక్తి కాలక్రమేణా ఆ దివ్య జ్ఞానాన్ని తన హృదయంలోనే స్వయంగా అనుభవిస్తాడు.
explanation: Knowledge is the supreme cleanser of confusion and self-doubt. When we invest in cultivating deep spiritual and intellectual wisdom rather than superficial fixes, our perception clarifies, revealing the path forward with unmistakable clarity.
core_concepts: Jnana (Purifying Knowledge), Inner Realization, Patience in Growth
life_situations: seeking clarity, spiritual curiosity, personal development, self-improvement, student struggles

slok_sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
transliteration:
uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet |
ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ ||
translation_en: Elevate yourself through the power of your own mind, and do not degrade yourself. For the mind can be the greatest friend of the self, and the mind can also be the worst enemy of the self.
translation_hi: मनुष्य को चाहिए कि वह अपने मन के द्वारा अपना उद्धार करे, अपने आपको नीचे न गिराए। क्योंकि यह मन ही जीवात्मा का परम मित्र है और मन ही उसका सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है।
translation_te: మనిషి తన మనస్సు ద్వారా తన్ను తాను ఉద్ధరించుకోవాలి గాని అధఃపాతాళానికి దిగజార్చుకోకూడదు. ఎందుకంటే మనస్సే మనిషికి ప్రాణమిత్రుడు, మనస్సే మనిషికి పరమ శత్రువు.
explanation: Lord Krishna presents the ultimate truth of self-agency. No external person can ruin you as thoroughly as negative self-talk, self-pity, and undisciplined thoughts. Equally, no external savior can lift you if your mind remains self-destructive. Train your mind to be your trusted ally.
core_concepts: Self-Mastery, Internal Locus of Control, Mental Allyship, Overcoming Depression
life_situations: low self-esteem, self-doubt, negative self-talk, feeling helpless, depression, lack of confidence, personal accountability

slok_sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
transliteration:
bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ |
anātmanas tu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatru-vat ||
translation_en: For one who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends; but for one who has failed to do so, the mind remains their greatest adversary, working like an enemy.
translation_hi: जिसने अपने मन को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए मन सबसे उत्तम मित्र है; परन्तु जो मन को वश में नहीं कर सका, उसका मन ही उसके लिए शत्रु के समान आचरण करता है।
translation_te: ఎవరైతే తన మనస్సును జయించారో వారికి మనస్సే శ్రేష్ఠమైన మిత్రుడు. మనస్సును వశం చేసుకోలేని వ్యక్తికి ఆ మనస్సే శత్రువులా ప్రవర్తిస్తూ హాని చేస్తుంది.
explanation: A disciplined mind executes your intentions, keeps promises, and remains tranquil under pressure. An undisciplined mind generates anxiety, indulges in bad habits, and sabotages dreams. Cultivating mind mastery is life's highest investment.
core_concepts: Conquering the Mind, Discipline vs Chaos, Mindful Habits
life_situations: addictions, bad habits, lack of focus, undisciplined lifestyle, procrastination, self-sabotage

slok_sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
transliteration:
yato yato niścarati manaś cañcalam asthiram |
tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmany eva vaśaṁ nayet ||
translation_en: From wherever the restless and unsteady mind wanders away, one should gently bring it back and center it within the self again.
translation_hi: यह चंचल और अस्थिर मन जहाँ-जहाँ भी भटकता है, वहाँ-वहाँ से इसे रोककर बार-बार आत्मा में ही स्थिर करना चाहिए।
translation_te: చంచలమైన, అస్థిరమైన మనస్సు ఎటువైపు పరిగెడుతుందో అటునుండి దాన్ని వెనక్కి తెచ్చి, నిగ్రహించి ఆత్మయందే స్థిరపరచాలి.
explanation: Krishna gives gentle, practical advice on mindfulness. Do not get angry at your mind when it wanders—wandering is its nature. The practice of meditation and focus is simply noticing the drift without judgment, and calmly bringing attention back to your breath, task, or center.
core_concepts: Mindfulness, Non-Judgmental Awareness, Focus Restoration, Gentle Discipline
life_situations: ADHD symptoms, study distractions, wandering mind during work, meditation difficulties, overthinking

slok_sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्॥
transliteration:
cañcalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham |
tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣkaram ||
translation_en: Arjuna said: O Krishna, the mind is indeed restless, turbulent, obstinate, and extraordinarily powerful. To control it seems as difficult as holding back the raging wind.
translation_hi: अर्जुन बोले: हे कृष्ण! यह मन बड़ा ही चंचल, प्रमथनशील (मथ डालने वाला), बलवान और दृढ़ है। इसलिए इसे वश में करना मुझे वायु को रोकने के समान अत्यन्त कठिन जान पड़ता है।
translation_te: అర్జునుడు అన్నాడు: ఓ కృష్ణా! ఈ మనస్సు చంచలమైనది, బలమైనది, కలవరపరిచేది, పట్టుదలతో కూడినది. గాలిని ఆపడం ఎంత అసాధ్యమో, ఈ మనస్సును నిగ్రహించడం కూడా అంతే కష్టమని నా భావన.
explanation: Arjuna validates our everyday human struggle. Even the greatest warrior in the world found his mind as fierce as a gale wind. Acknowledging that mind control is genuinely difficult frees us from false guilt and opens the door to systematic practice.
core_concepts: Human Vulnerability, Validating Struggle, The Restless Nature of Thought
life_situations: severe overthinking, restlessness, anxiety attacks, feeling overwhelmed, intellectual struggle

slok_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca |
asaṁśayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ calam |
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||
translation_en: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the mind is restless and difficult to curb. But it can be mastered through consistent practice (Abhyasa) and healthy detachment (Vairagya).
translation_hi: श्रीभगवान ने कहा: हे महाबाहो! निःसंदेह मन चंचल और कठिनता से वश में होने वाला है। परन्तु हे कुन्तीपुत्र! यह निरंतर अभ्यास (अभ्यास) और वैराग्य (अनासक्ति) से वश में हो जाता है।
translation_te: శ్రీభగవానుడు పలికెను: ఓ బాహుబలుడా! నిస్సందేహంగా మనస్సు చంచలమైనది, నిగ్రహించడం కష్టమైనదే. కానీ ఓ కుంతీపుత్రా! నిరంతర సాధన (అభ్యాసం) మరియు వైరాగ్యం ద్వారా దాన్ని తప్పక వశం చేసుకోవచ్చు.
explanation: Krishna gives the twin keys to psychological mastery: Abhyasa (daily, persistent habit and repetition) and Vairagya (letting go of trivial obsessions and attachments). Transformation is not achieved in an instant epiphanic moment, but through gentle daily discipline.
core_concepts: Abhyasa (Persistent Practice), Vairagya (Detachment), Systematic Growth
life_situations: habit change, overcoming mental turmoil, exam preparation, mastering anxiety, consistency struggles

slok_sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
transliteration:
ananyāś cintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
teṣāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham ||
translation_en: To those who are constantly devoted to Me and meditate upon Me with undistracted minds, I personally supply what they lack and safeguard what they already possess.
translation_hi: जो अनन्य भक्त केवल मेरा ही चिंतन करते हुए निष्काम भाव से मेरी उपासना करते हैं, उन निरंतर मुझमें लगे रहने वाले भक्तों के योग (अभाव की पूर्ति) और क्षेम (जो है उसकी रक्षा) का वहन मैं स्वयं करता हूँ।
translation_te: ఎవరైతే అనన్యమైన భక్తితో నన్నే నిరంతరం స్మరిస్తూ సేవిస్తారో, అటువంటి నిత్యసమర్పణ భావం గల భక్తుల యోగక్షేమాలను (లేనిదాన్ని అందించడం, ఉన్నదాన్ని రక్షించడం) నేనే స్వయంగా వహిస్తాను.
explanation: One of the most comforting verses in Vedic literature. Lord Krishna guarantees 'Yoga-Kshema'—He personally provides what is needed and preserves what is earned to the sincere soul whose heart is aligned with righteousness and devotion. It dissolves the haunting dread of financial or emotional insecurity.
core_concepts: Divine Protection, Yoga-Kshema, Total Trust, Freedom from Financial Insecurity
life_situations: financial insecurity, anxiety about future provision, loneliness, fear of starvation, trusting the divine

slok_sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥
transliteration:
adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca |
nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī ||
translation_en: One who is not envious of any creature, who is kind and compassionate to all, free from the sense of possessiveness and false pride, steady in both joy and sorrow, and patient and forgiving—such a soul is very dear to Me.
translation_hi: जो किसी भी प्राणी से द्वेष नहीं करता, सबका मित्र और दयालु है, ममता और अहंकार से रहित है, सुख-दुःख में समान रहता है और क्षमावान है—वह भक्त मुझे अत्यन्त प्रिय है।
translation_te: సమస్త ప్రాణులపట్ల ద్వేషం లేనివాడు, మైత్రీభావం, దయ కలిగినవాడు, నాది అనే మమకారం, అహంకారం లేనివాడు, సుఖదుఃఖాలందు సమానుడు, క్షమాగుణం గలవాడే నాకు ప్రియమైనవాడు.
explanation: Krishna reveals the true hallmark of spiritual maturity: compassionate social conduct. Not rituals or dogmas, but kindness towards all beings, releasing arrogant ego, forgiving those who hurt us, and walking through world with an open, friendly heart.
core_concepts: Universal Compassion, Forgiveness, Egolessness, Loving Kindness
life_situations: relationship bitterness, toxic colleagues, forgiveness struggles, overcoming grudge, family disputes

slok_sanskrit:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
transliteration:
tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśanam ātmanaḥ |
kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet ||
translation_en: There are three gates leading to the hell of self-destruction: lust (insatiable desire), anger, and greed. Therefore, every sane person must abandon these three.
translation_hi: काम, क्रोध और लोभ—ये आत्मा का नाश करने वाले नरक के तीन द्वार हैं। इसलिए इन तीनों का पूर्ण रूप से त्याग कर देना चाहिए।
translation_te: కామం, క్రోధం మరియు లోభం—ఈ మూడూ ఆత్మను నాశనం చేసే నరక ద్వారాలు. కాబట్టి వివేకవంతుడైన మనిషి ఈ మూడింటిని వెంటనే విడిచిపెట్టాలి.
explanation: Hell is not merely a distant realm; it is an internal state created by obsession (Kama), resentment (Krodha), and unquenchable greed (Lobha). Whenever these three drive decisions, they corrupt ethics, fracture families, and dismantle inner serenity. Identifying them is the first step to emotional liberation.
core_concepts: The Three Gates of Self-Ruin, Greed, Anger, Ethical Cleansing
life_situations: destructive desires, runaway greed, road rage, ethical compromises, workplace burnout, addiction

slok_sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
transliteration:
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā |
vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
translation_en: Thus I have explained to you wisdom that is secret of all secrets. Ponder over it deeply in its entirety, and then act as you choose.
translation_hi: इस प्रकार मैंने तुम्हें गोपनीय से भी अति गोपनीय ज्ञान सुनाया है। अब तू इस पर भली-भाँति विचार कर, और फिर जैसा तू उचित समझे, वैसा कर।
translation_te: ఈ విధంగా రహస్యాలన్నింటిలోకెల్లా పరమ రహస్యమైన జ్ఞానాన్ని నేను నీకు ఉపదేశించాను. దీనిని సంపూర్ణంగా విచారించి, నీకు ఎలా తోస్తే అలా చేయి.
explanation: Krishna proves Himself the ultimate spiritual teacher who champions human autonomy. Having imparted profound wisdom, He does not force or dictate dogma. He says: 'Reflect deeply, apply your intellect, and then make your own conscious choice.' Spiritual wisdom respects individual agency and empowerment.
core_concepts: Free Will, Intellectual Discernment, Autonomy, Conscious Choice
life_situations: decision paralysis, choosing between paths, religious pressure, moral dilemma, autonomy, life crossroads

slok_sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
transliteration:
sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja |
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||
translation_en: Abandon all varieties of worldly duties and anxieties, and simply surrender unto Me alone. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions and distress; do not grieve.
translation_hi: संपूर्ण धर्मों के आडंबर और चिंताओं को त्यागकर केवल मेरी शरण में आ जा। मैं तुझे समस्त पापों और कष्टों से मुक्त कर दूँगा; तू शोक मत कर।
translation_te: సమస్త ధర్మాలను, చింతలను విడిచిపెట్టి నా ఒక్కని శరణు వేడుము. నేను నిన్ను సమస్త పాపముల నుండి, దుఃఖముల నుండి విముక్తుడిని చేస్తాను; శోకించకుము.
explanation: The supreme crest-jewel of the Gita: the Mahavākya of unconditional surrender (Sharanagati). When a person has tried everything humanly possible and still feels crushed by guilt, exhaustion, and anxiety, Krishna invites them to let down their heavy burdens at the altar of the Divine. 'Mā śucaḥ'—Do not grieve.
core_concepts: Sharanagati (Absolute Surrender), Divine Grace, Unburdening Grief, Supreme Peace
life_situations: exhaustion, burnout, overwhelming guilt, rock bottom, despair, surrender, finding hope

slok_sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
transliteration:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |
tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama ||
translation_en: Wherever there is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there will certainly be opulence, victory, prosperity, and unwavering morality. This is my firm conviction.
translation_hi: जहाँ योगेश्वर श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ गाण्डीवधारी अर्जुन हैं, वहीं श्री (ऐश्वर्य), विजय, समृद्धि और अटल नीति हैं—यह मेरा निश्चित मत है।
translation_te: ఎక్కడ యోగేశ్వరుడైన శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, ఎక్కడ గాండీవధారియైన అర్జునుడు ఉంటారో, అక్కడ ఖచ్చితంగా ఐశ్వర్యం, విజయం, అభ్యుదయం మరియు అచంచలమైన నీతి ఉంటాయని నా దృఢమైన నమ్మకం.
explanation: The closing verse of the Gita provides the ultimate formula for success in life: the union of Divine Wisdom (Krishna) and Dedicated Human Effort (Arjuna with bow in hand). Grace without effort breeds complacency; effort without spiritual wisdom breeds burnout and chaos. When ethical action meets spiritual clarity, victory is guaranteed.
core_concepts: Synergy of Grace and Effort, True Success, Moral Victory, Life Triumph
life_situations: startup success, winning ethical battles, balancing hard work and faith, overcoming setbacks, inspiration
